create.name: Judy Ramsey
create.bio:
Working from her farm near Ann Arbor, Michigan, under the name Heart to Heart, Judy Liu Ramsey is an animal communicator, shamanic practitioner and ordained animal chaplain. She holds an MA from the University of Michigan and was a social work counsellor and craniosacral therapist before she turned to animal communication nearly twenty years ago. Penelope Smith trained her in telepathic animal communication and Teresa Wagner in grief and hospice communication. Her shamanic practice developed through mentoring with Sandra Ingerman and others, with further study under Tom Cowan, Alberto Villoldo and Betsy Bergstrom, and in 2023 she was ordained through the Compassion Consortium.

Her animal communication teaching runs across four levels, from basic telepathic communication up to interspecies counselling. Sandra Ingerman has approved her to teach Ingerman's own courses, among them Basic Journeying, Healing with Spiritual Light and Medicine for the Earth, along with advanced practitioner trainings. Most of her classes are live on Zoom; she also holds an online journey circle twice a month, gives private sessions for people and their animals, and leads small-group cultural journeys to Peru. She is practical and grounded, encouraging students to grow still and let the animals teach them. On YouTube she shares guided shamanic journeys and drumming for journeying.

courses.title: Online Journey Circle
courses.description: A twice-monthly Zoom circle, on the first and third Thursday evenings, for people who already know how to journey. Participants use shamanic journeying to explore questions on their own life path. The first session is free once Judy has confirmed your journeying skills.
courses.price: $25 USD per session or $40 USD per month

courses.title: Basic Journeying: The Art of Shamanism for Practical and Visionary Purposes in Daily Life
courses.description: A two-day Zoom class introducing the shamanic journey as a way to receive spiritual guidance. Students meet a compassionate spirit or power animal and learn to build a safe, self-directed practice. It is the prerequisite for her more advanced shamanic classes.

courses.title: Shamanic Animal Communication
courses.description: Six weekly evening sessions on Zoom exploring the difference between telepathic and shamanic animal communication and how to combine them. No prior telepathic communication experience is needed, and optional mentoring sessions follow each class.

courses.title: Basic Telepathic Animal Communication
courses.description: A two-day Zoom class on communicating with animals the way they communicate with each other. Exercises help students open their intuitive perception safely and playfully. Penelope Smith's book Animal Talk is the prerequisite reading.

courses.title: Healing With Spiritual Light & Medicine for the Earth
courses.description: A six-week evening course on Zoom, based on Sandra Ingerman's work, exploring one's inner light and connection with nature, spirit allies and the elements. It teaches ways to transform the energy behind difficult thoughts and bring balance to oneself and one's surroundings. Open to all levels; journeying skills are not needed.

courses.title: Andean Exploration: Colca Canyon, Lake Titicaca, Sacred Valley, Cusco & Machu Picchu
courses.description: A fifteen-day small-group cultural journey through the Andes led by Judy, visiting Colca Canyon, Lake Titicaca, the Sacred Valley, Cusco and Machu Picchu with native guides. It includes ceremonies and cultural events with local Andean specialists.
courses.price: $4,900 USD ($4,500 USD early bird until 31 December 2026)

free_resources.title: Shamanic Drumming 5 minutes
free_resources.description: A five-minute drumming track for a short shamanic journey. It can be used as a steady rhythm for a brief, self-guided journeying practice.

free_resources.title: Shamanic Drumming 15 minutes
free_resources.description: A fifteen-minute drumming track for a longer shamanic journey. It gives a steady beat to journey to, for those who already know the practice.
